CustomObject.description: Fired by OrderTriggerHandler.afterUpdate whenever an Order transitions to Status=Activated. Subscribed by the platform-event trigger that hands off to SapSalesOrderService for SAP SD posting (ADR-023). Decoupling SF-side activation from outbound SAP integration via this event lets the activation transaction commit cleanly before any SAP callout runs (avoids "uncommitted work pending" on synchronous push patterns).
CustomObject.label: Order Activated
